**Article Details for PMID: 42400217**

**Title:** Efficacy, Safety, and Treatment-Delivery Feasibility of Autologous Gene Therapy for Sickle Cell Disease: A Systematic Review With Descriptive Synthesis of Clinical Trials.

**Authors:** Mahboob Younus Shaik, Stephen Divers

**Journal:** European journal of haematology
**Publication Date:** 2026-10-07
**DOI:** 10.1111/ejh.70260

**Abstract:**
Severe sickle cell disease (SCD) leads to recurrent vaso-occlusive events (VOEs), progressive organ damage, and premature death. Autologous gene therapy has emerged as a potential curative strategy, but trial efficacy must be interpreted together with mobilization, apheresis collection, manufacturing, conditioning, cost, fertility preservation, and long-term surveillance requirements.

**Note:** Full text is not available in PubMed Central. You may need institutional access or subscription to view the complete article.
